name: SEA – Syddansk Erhvervsakademi
about: SEA is a business academy with campuses in Esbjerg, Sønderborg and Tønder, formerly Erhvervsakademi SydVest (Business Academy SouthWest). Its two English-taught first-year AP degrees are in Esbjerg: Computer Science and Multimedia Design. These combine theory with practical projects and an internship; each is a short-cycle qualification rather than a bachelor's.

languageOfInstruction.note: The two English-taught AP degrees and two top-ups are all in Esbjerg.

sources.title: SEA's English-taught programmes in Esbjerg are the Computer Science and Multimedia Design AP degrees, plus two top-up bachelors (Software Development and Web Development).
Erhvervsakademi SydVest is the former name of the current SEA; the legacy Business Academy SouthWest lead reuses dk-sea.
The Danish Agency lists EA Business Academy SouthWest among its recognised business academies; SEA supplies its current name.
SEA publishes AP application documents, fee exemptions and group-specific document guidance; final IB timing needs an agreed arrangement.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: optagelse.dk applications with an international qualification close 15 March at noon. Current transcripts may precede graduation. The EU section allows enclosures until 5 July noon, non-EU until 1 May noon, and later diplomas require contacting SEA. The date table retains a 26 August 2026 start. EU/EEA/Swiss students and listed qualifying residence-permit holders are tuition-exempt; others pay.

sources.title: SEA FAQ gives an international-exam document date conflicting with its full-degree guide and limits housing assistance to exchange students.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: summer documents generally reach 5 July but applicants with international qualifying examinations are given 1 April. NemStudie carries messages, offers and acceptance. Housing help is limited to Erasmus/exchange students. The important-dates table retains a 2026 study start.

sources.title: SEA links a tariff labelled 2024/2027; autumn 2027 applicability is unconfirmed.
sources.quote: Structured restatement of the visually read AP table: semester one including registration EUR 7,500 / DKK 56,250; semester two EUR 4,900 / DKK 36,750; year two (semesters three and four) EUR 8,000 / DKK 60,000; Computer Science semester five EUR 2,000 / DKK 15,000. The heading reads 2024/2027. Retaking year one is a separate EUR 8,000 / DKK 60,000 charge.

sources.title: SEA lists two English first-year AP programmes in Esbjerg; the other two English degrees require prior AP study.

notes: Erhvervsakademi SydVest / Business Academy SouthWest is the former name of SEA. Its English first-year AP degrees are in Esbjerg; Sønderborg and Tønder are other institutional campuses.
English B remains a subject requirement on both AP degrees. SEA exempts holders of an International Baccalaureate exam from an English test; whether this includes DP Course Results is not published.

SEA's international-document dates conflict: its FAQ says 1 April, while its full-degree guide says 5 July for EU applicants and 1 May for non-EU applicants. The guide tells applicants receiving their diploma later to contact SEA. Agree the final IB-results arrangement before applying; no separate predicted-grade deadline is published.

EU/EEA/Swiss students pay no tuition; certain Danish residence permits also exempt other students. SEA's linked tariff is labelled 2024/2027: first semester €7,500 including registration, second semester €4,900, year two €8,000, plus €2,000 for Computer Science's fifth semester. Confirm autumn 2027 fees before budgeting.
Full-degree students find their own housing. SEA's offered rooms and housing prices on the international landing page concern Erasmus/exchange students.

SEA sets the offer-acceptance procedure in the individual admission letter in nemStudie; no public 2027 reply date is stated. Arrange the final IB-results delivery method and recipient details with SEA; the IB release date does not establish permission to submit after its document deadline.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is an erhvervsakademiuddannelse (AP degree), which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

requirements.label: English documented with a test (applicants with a foreign entrance examination)
requirements.openQuestion: SEA exempts "an International Baccalaureate exam"; whether that includes DP Course Results is not published. Ask SEA before you rely on it.
requirements.note: SEA: "All applicants holding a foreign entrance examination must document their English qualifications, and English tests must be submitted" … "Applicants holding Nordic and German entrance exams, an International Baccalaureate exam or applicants who have English as their native language are exempt from the requirement." Met by the full IB Diploma; whether the exemption reaches DP Course Results is not published. For applicants who need a test, the current programme page lists IELTS 6.5, TOEFL internet-based 94 or paper-based 560, Cambridge Proficiency or Advanced, Oxford Placement B2 with 75 in each part, or CEFR B2/C1; the test must be under two years old. Confirm the accepted sitting and score scale with SEA.

requirements.openQuestion: SEA exempts "an International Baccalaureate exam"; whether that includes DP Course Results is not published. Ask SEA before you rely on it.

Met by the full IB Diploma; whether the exemption reaches DP Course Results is not published. For applicants who need a test, the current programme page lists IELTS 6.5, TOEFL internet-based 94 or paper-based 560, Cambridge Proficiency or Advanced, Oxford Placement B2 with 75 in each part, or CEFR B2/C1; the test must be under two years old. Confirm the accepted sitting and score scale with SEA.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

notes: An AP degree is a short-cycle qualification (EQF level 5), not a bachelor's degree.
The main IB application deadline remains the national March route; the programme-page 5 July 2027 quota 1 headline is not the IB application deadline.

SEA's FAQ and full-degree guide disagree on document deadlines. The guide permits a current transcript before graduation and asks applicants receiving diplomas after its deadline to contact SEA. Final May-session IB results require an agreed arrangement; no separate predicted-grade deadline or automatic late-results acceptance is published.
SEA's linked fee table is labelled 2024/2027; its continuing applicability to autumn 2027 is unconfirmed. Non-EU status alone does not rule out a residence-based tuition exemption.
